sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: Tadg is an Irish name found in myth and history. The best known bearer was Tadg mac Nuadat. He was Fionn Mac Cumhaill's grandfather. Readers link the name Tadg to the god Nuada. The name also marks a son of Nuada. Another Tadg fostered King Cormac Mac Airt. A third Tadg was the son of Ciabhan who met the fairy queen Clidna.
